notes.title: 1.0.0 is here!
notes.content:
Join the conversation on [url=https://discord.savethecastle.net]discord[/url]

[b]---1.0.0 (Current as of 1/16/2024)---[/b]

[b]SHE'S HERE!!!!![/b]
18 months of hard work later, and I cannot thank my community and playtesters enough. 
I hope you enjoy the game, I've been told it's fun :)

>All 3 maps are fully playable
>>Added Frozen Wastes
>>Added Cactus Dunes (good luck...)

>Tob purrs
>Can skip opening splash screen
>Various bug fixes / tweaks / balance patches

notes.title: NextFest update!
notes.content:
Play the demo today! 
Then [url=https://savethecastle.net]wishlist[/url] the main game!
Join the conversation on [url=https://discord.savethecastle.net]discord[/url]

[b]---0.6.4 (Current as of 10/14/2024)---[/b]
>Money tracked with piggy bank model
>>Pig oinks on click
>Level trackers now in snow globes
>Wall tracker (built / lost)


>Stats functional first pass!
>All towers need:
>> # towers built 
>> # towers lost
>>> # towers lost (while player in that tower)
>> # auto kills
>> # player weapon kills
>> a functional /animated model in main menu w/ stats
>> towers animate on drop / reset

>All stats:
>>Return to shelf when dropped
>>Show stat on ui hover
>>Move stat to better view if held


[b]---0.6.3 (Current as of 9/27/2024)---[/b]
>Can grab / reposition tutorial window
>Flowers grow!
